notes: All accepted repeated timings were collected after the user switched to battery; low-power mode was off.
Fresh processes, one complete pass, warm application/OS caches. Retex snapshots and watch mode disabled. Neither compiler uses incremental checkpoints.
XeTeX XDV avoids xdvipdfmx and is the more relevant comparison for TeXpresso. Retex still produces PDF.
Body markers span just after begin-document to clearpage before end-document: they include layout, shipout and output backpressure, but exclude preamble and final document teardown.
wait4 CPU is child/descendant accounting; RSS is OS process peak accounting, not simultaneous unique group RAM or checkpoint memory.
Two complete warm rounds (42 observations) overlapped an auxiliary diff and were explicitly excluded; rounds 5 and 6 replaced them.
Retex draftmode writes a scratch PDF, so it is not a backend-free typesetting measurement.
Representative edited outputs are the final repetition in each phase; the literal sentence is verified and the edited TikZ page changes raster.
No browser, MuPDF, extension IPC or integrated edit-to-paint benchmark is included.
